learning.conditions: Free self-paced online learning at freeCodeCamp. An account is needed to save progress and later claim the certificate; the certification path includes five required certification projects and an exam.

outcomes.name: Responsive Web Design Certification (freeCodeCamp, v9)
outcomes.requirements: Complete the five certification projects, meeting their automated project tests, to qualify for the 50-question exam. Accept the freeCodeCamp academic honesty pledge, take and pass the freeCodeCamp Exam Environment desktop exam, then await staff moderation of results. After a passing result, claim the certificate in account settings. The issuer's published FAQ describes English-only exams and a minimum 168-hour interval between attempts; recheck these details if they change.

evidence.review_note: freeCodeCamp's dated launch announcement identifies the live certification and links to its canonical v9 course URL.
Official launch article links directly to the v9 learning page; direct page content is JavaScript-rendered and was not parsed for independent claims.

evidence.short_quote: Every aspect of freeCodeCamp is 100% free.
evidence.review_note: The provider's currently indexed home page explicitly states that courses, projects, and certifications are free.
The issuer says the new course-specific certification is live and obtainable by completing its exam path.
Five completed certification projects are prerequisites to unlock the exam.
The current v9 certification includes a separate 50-question exam; project completion alone is not sufficient.

evidence.short_quote: All exam attempts are reviewed by freeCodeCamp staff
evidence.review_note: The issuer moderates exam submissions before releasing results; a submission alone does not guarantee a certificate.
A freeCodeCamp support responder identifies acceptance of the academic honesty pledge as an exam prerequisite.
freeCodeCamp community support describes the claim step in account settings after a passed and moderated exam.
The issuer explicitly includes certifications in the free offerings. Its v9 launch FAQ also confirms the exams are free.
